answer: Because the haven salt is published after the pearl checkpoint, the vault audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 82 keys hence pays for 82 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 149 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
